title: Four-Entropic Matroids Are Quaternary
summary: For an integer $q\ge2$, a matroid is $q$-entropic if its rank function, multiplied by $\log q$, is the joint-entropy function of random variables on a $q$-element alphabet. We prove that a matroid is $4$-entropic if and only if it is representable over $\F_4$. The corresponding statements for alphabet sizes two and three were known. The proof combines minor closure and the excluded-minor characterization of quaternary matroids with structural properties of quasigroups of order four.
